scope: Read-only representative F2 DEV capture; no FINAL access, inference, scoring, or live changes

source_audit.finding: Entire generated continuation is decoded with skip_special_tokens=False and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False. Only terminal EOS and subsequent batch padding are excluded from raw. token_ids retains EOS. For purpose=held, no parser/enact call precedes CALL serialization; the full response object is written before attached open/focused readouts. No final-answer extraction replaces raw.

cpu_verification.method: Node-local cached AutoTokenizer with native tokenizer.json backend restoration; decode saved token_ids excluding EOS with native flags; assert byte-identical response.raw

interpretation_limit: Preserves all emitted reasoning/protocol/answer text, not hidden thoughts. Storage fidelity is verified; meaningful reasoning, semantic novelty, and correctness are not assessed. Raw text remains node-local.
